Bruk konto 6010 for avskrivingskostnad og 1209 for akkumulerte avskrivingar. 2) Reverser forskotsbetalt kostnad (totalt 55250 kr på konto 1700). 3) Rekn ut og bokfør skattekostnad (22 % av skattbart resultat) på konto 8700/2920. payload.goal: Forenkla årsoppgjer for 2025: berekne og bokføre årlege avskrivingar for tre eigedelar som eigne bilag, reversere forskotsbetalt kostnad på konto 1700, og bokføre skattekostnad 22 % av skattbart resultat på konto 8700/2920.
likely_resources: trial balance or taxable result for 2025
success_checks: Tre separate avskrivingsbilag er bokførte for 2025 med korrekt beløp per eigedel.
Konto 6010 er debetert og konto 1209 kreditert for kvar avskriving.
Forskotsbetalt kostnad på konto 1700 er reversert med totalt 55250 kr.
Skattekostnad er bokført med 22 % av skattbart resultat på konto 8700/2920.
Alle bilag er daterte i 2025 og balanserer.
risk_notes: Skattbart resultat er ikkje oppgitt, så skattekostnad kan ikkje reknast ut endeleg utan dette talet.
Det er ikkje oppgitt eksakt bilagsdato i 2025; årssluttdato bør avklarast, typisk 2025-12-31.
Bruk av felles konto 1209 for akkumulerte avskrivingar på fleire eigedelar kan avvike frå kontoplanpraksis; bekreft at dette er ønskt.
Reversering av forskotsbetalt kostnad manglar motkonto; må avklarast eller hentast frå opphavleg periodisering/resultatkonto.
payload.suggested_first_action: Hent eller avklar skattbart resultat for 2025 og ønskja bilagsdato, deretter opprett første avskrivingsbilag for Inventar.

Create separate voucher dated 2025-12-31 for Kjøretøy depreciation: debit 6010 = 55635.71, credit 1209 = 55635.71; include reference to asset account 1230.
Create separate voucher dated 2025-12-31 for Programvare depreciation: debit 6010 = 54450.00, credit 1209 = 54450.00; include reference to asset account 1250.
Create reversal voucher dated 2025-12-31 to reverse prepaid expense on account 1700 for 55250.00 against the original expense/result account once identified.
Fetch or calculate taxable result for 2025 from ledger/reporting.
Create tax voucher dated 2025-12-31: debit 8700 and credit 2920 for computed tax amount.
Verify all vouchers balance, are posted in 2025, and totals match requested calculations.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.headline: 3 depreciation vouchers failed due to account ID type error; only prepaid reversal succeeded
what_went_wrong: Account 1209 lookup returned resource_id=None, meaning the account wasn't found, yet the agent still used '$REF:account_1209' placeholder which resolved to wrong type causing 422 errors on all 3 depreciation vouchers.
The agent gave up on depreciation vouchers after 3 failures instead of trying alternative approaches (e.g., creating account 1209 or using a different accumulated depreciation account that exists).
Account 8700 also not found (resource_id=None), so tax cost voucher was never attempted, causing checks 3-6 to fail.
The reversal of prepaid cost used account 6010 as debit instead of the correct reversal entry (debit 1700, credit expense account), and no tax calculation was performed.
what_worked: Successfully posted the prepaid cost reversal voucher (55250 kr) on account 1700, passing check 2.
Account lookups for existing accounts (1230, 1240, 1250, 6010, 1700, 2920) were completed correctly.
what_to_try_next: When account lookup returns resource_id=None, attempt to create the missing account (POST /ledger/account) before posting vouchers that reference it.
After fixing account 1209 and 8700 issues, use the actual integer account IDs (not $REF placeholders) directly in voucher postings to avoid type mapping errors.
To calculate taxable result for tax posting, query GET /ledger/balance or GET /ledger/openPost for income/expense accounts before computing 22% tax and posting to 8700/2920.
unnecessary_calls: Two extra GET /ledger/account calls after the failed vouchers (checking accounts that already returned None) added no value.
search_tripletex_api for 'taxable result ledger reporting' was unused and could be skipped in favor of direct ledger balance queries.
